sanity_expectations: At fixed moderate P_O2 (for example 50-60 mmHg), V_E should increase monotonically with P_CO2 but with a visibly decreasing incremental slope above P_CO2_ref because K_CO2_compression > 0 acts before the common saturation.

At fixed P_CO2, lowering P_O2 from normoxia toward severe hypoxia should increase V_E, with a broader shoulder in moderate hypoxia and a steeper late rise than a single-logistic hypoxic recruitment would give because alpha_hypoxia > 1.

Comparing fixed-P_O2 slices, the V_E-versus-P_CO2 slope should be steeper at low P_O2 than at high P_O2 due to K_CO2_hypoxia > 0; this amplification should appear before the highest-V_E points are reached.

Comparing fixed-P_CO2 slices, the oxygen tension where ventilation begins to rise sharply should shift with P_CO2 because Delta_P_O2_half_CO2 < 0, so higher P_CO2 recruits hypoxic effects at less severe hypoxia.

Across P_O2 sweeps, the onset of stronger CO2 sensitivity should occur at a different P_O2 than the onset of the direct hypoxic increment because Delta_P_O2_half_potentiation is nonzero; with the chosen negative value, CO2 potentiation should emerge at milder hypoxia than the direct hypoxic-drive rise.
Predicted outputs remain bounded below V_E_max and nonnegative over the sampled grid; only the low-O2/high-CO2 corner should approach the ceiling strongly.
role_corrections: V_E: claimed-output/target derivative -> dependent_variable (confirmed: explicit algebraic target, not a derivative)
P_CO2: claimed-input/time axis -> independent_variable (confirmed: sampled clamp axis, not time)
P_O2: claimed-input/time axis -> independent_variable (confirmed: sampled clamp axis, not time)
rationale: Structural analysis shows a static explicit algebraic mapping with no derivatives, no integrals, and no hidden dynamic states, so the declared output V_E and sampled axes P_CO2 and P_O2 are confirmed. The chosen grid directly matches the steady clamp experiment: P_CO2 is varied from mild hypocapnia to marked hypercapnia around the reference 40 mmHg, and P_O2 is varied from normoxic/hyperoxic values down into clear hypoxia without forcing all conditions into the final motor ceiling. Parameter values are selected to keep the expression finite and real and to expose the intended child mechanisms away from recovery limits: K_CO2_hypoxia > 0 gives stronger CO2 sensitivity in hypoxia; Delta_P_O2_half_CO2 < 0 makes elevated CO2 shift the hypoxic knee toward higher O2 sensitivity; alpha_hypoxia > 1 broadens moderate-hypoxia onset and sharpens severe-hypoxia rise relative to a single logistic; K_CO2_compression > 0 introduces pre-ceiling flattening of the CO2 branch at high P_CO2; Delta_P_O2_half_potentiation = -10 mmHg separates the O2 threshold for CO2 potentiation from the threshold for direct hypoxic drive while staying within the supplied admissible range. The P_O2 span intentionally crosses both threshold surfaces and the P_CO2 span crosses the reference level and extends high enough for compressive curvature, so fixed-P_O2 V_E-versus-P_CO2 slices and fixed-P_CO2 V_E-versus-P_O2 slices both show the recorded contrasts. Some high-CO2/low-O2 corners will approach saturation, but much of the grid remains submaximal, which is necessary to distinguish intrinsic CO2 compression and threshold separation from the common output ceiling.
